trigger: A fresh task arrives or the correct direct/crew/runtime route is uncertain.
steps: Read AGENTS.md, CODEBASE_MAP.md, HARNESS.md, and the First Mate operational manifest.
Inspect active branch/PR ownership before mutation; preserve other writers.
Use direct AgentSwitchboard for one-writer work or unsupported platforms.
Use First Mate local-only only for parallel Linux/WSL work after the floor passes.
Keep tmux as the reference session backend; a Herdr request remains blocked while manifest selection is disabled.
failure_handling: If repository ownership, First Mate readiness, or runtime support is unresolved, return blocked with the owning lane and do not invent compatibility.
proof_ceiling: workflow-state evidence only unless the owning runtime/validator produces stronger proof
